## Summary

Describe **what is implemented** and what remains proposed. Link the issue/roadmap entry.

## Change category

- [ ] Game IO / UI
- [ ] New hook adapter (include exact executable hash)
- [ ] Settings / patches / safety
- [ ] Companion API / offline tool
- [ ] Tests / documentation

## Evidence and regression testing

- [ ] Windows build and CTest passing
- [ ] Python unittests passing (if modified)
- [ ] Original Windows XP SP3 checked, or explicitly **NOT TESTED**
- [ ] At least one named game build tested, or explicitly **NOT TESTED**
- [ ] Synthetic/right-cleared example included
- [ ] Incorrect game version and failure-path behavior reviewed

## Privacy, security and licensing

- [ ] No undocumented automatic uploads, credentials or raw device identifiers
- [ ] Hook failure does not block gameplay
- [ ] No copyrighted game/audio/video assets without permission
- [ ] GPL upstream attribution and third-party notices remain intact
- [ ] Documentation, changelog and compatibility matrix updated
